issues.legal_issue: A holder of transferable land rights may bequeath those rights subject to a life estate, and the life estate does not enlarge into an absolute interest when the life tenant took under the will rather than as an heir.
material_facts: The landholder bequeathed a life estate to his wife and the remainder to their daughters.
The wife entered possession under the will and later made a will in favour of the appellants.
In consolidation proceedings, the daughters’ claim to the land rights was ultimately upheld.
issues.conclusion: The wife held only the life estate created by the will; it did not enlarge into an absolute interest. The daughters were entitled to be recognised as holders of the land rights under the remainder bequest.
issues.legal_principle: Section 169(1) of the U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1951 expressly recognises a holder of transferable rights’ power to bequeath a holding or part of it by will, including subjecting it to a life estate. The Hindu personal law rules concerning a widow’s estate did not apply because the wife took under a will, not as an heir. Moniram Kolita v. Keerry Kolitany and Janaki Ammal v. Narayanasami Aiyer explain that a Hindu widow’s estate is not a limited estate in the English-law sense; those decisions therefore did not describe the interest created here. Ramji Dixit v. Bhrigunath and Prema Devi v. Joint Director of Consolidation were distinguished because the women in those cases acquired rights as Hindu widows. Balbhadra v. Board of Revenue was approved. Sections 155 and 156, concerning mortgages and leases, were irrelevant to the issue.

rule.if: transferable_land_rights and testamentary_life_estate and designated_remainder_beneficiaries and life_tenant_took_under_will and consolidation_rights_dispute

predicates.transferable_land_rights: The person making the disposition held land rights that could be transferred.
predicates.testamentary_life_estate: The landholder’s will gave one beneficiary an interest lasting for life.
predicates.designated_remainder_beneficiaries: The will designated other beneficiaries to take the land rights after the life interest ended.
predicates.life_tenant_took_under_will: The life tenant obtained the interest under the will rather than inheriting it as an heir.
predicates.consolidation_rights_dispute: The dispute arose in proceedings to determine who should be recognised as holding the land rights.

issues.definition: When a transferable-rights holder creates a life interest by will for one beneficiary and designates others to take afterwards, and the life tenant took under the will, the designated remainder beneficiaries are recognised as the land-rights holders in a consolidation rights dispute.
